reason: task348 active grid <=10x10 => C*active_cells (10*100=1000) >= full_grid_cells (900): exactly the by_symptom #500 boundary where free-output one-hot folds LOSE. The chevron presence is a rank~L (<=9) staircase, so the separable col operand needs ~10 row-level terms; parity doubles them and the background fold adds more; the data-dependent col content (Cw) plus the [10,30] placement-to-30 operand cannot be made static. The 900B canvas + cheap U8 build chain (v5) is structurally cheaper than encoding staircase x parity x bg as separable Einsum operands. Confirms task348.md #68 formulation-relative floor proof: free-Einsum was the one un-priced final-op family, now priced at 3120 > 1693.
